title: Wanka Quechua - Wikipedia
text: (Redirected from Jauja Wanca Quechua).Wanka Quechua (Wanka Limay, Wanka Nunashimi) is a Quechuan language (part of the Quechua languages), spoken in the southern part of Peruvian region of Junín by the Wanka people.

title: Quechua, Jauja Wanca | Ethnologue Free
text: Jauja Wanca Quechua is an endangered indigenous language of Peru. It belongs to the Quechuan language family and is part of the Quechua macrolanguage. The language is used as a first language by older adults only.
